reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR on the sachet and the "Every batch lab-tested" line, which is rare for TikTok Shop supplements. At about $1 a day with free shipping I would try one box of the single bisglycinate, but only if it is on a flash sale or has a coupon.
objection: Only 3 forms in the Complex when other brands put 8 or 14 in one capsule, so it looks thin for the money. Also $29.99 is full price and I usually wait for a deal.
would_change_my_mind: A coupon or flash price around $24 would make me buy sooner, and a real batch report behind the QR would make me reorder.
